propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote Terraform modules and Helm charts for the settlement-file service's UAT and performance-test clusters.
propositions.rationale: The resume names the clusters the infrastructure code was written for.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate deployed the settlement-file service to production and has operated it since March, producing the end-of-day settlement file for every branch.
propositions.rationale: The production statement combines the candidate's own phrase with a remark relayed from the client bank's release manager; the documented sources place the candidate's work in UAT, pre-production and performance-test clusters and state that release management held production approval and carried out deployments. The deployment rule does not allow pre-production work to be described as production operation.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds a Certified Kubernetes Administrator certificate shown as valid on the issuer's verification page.
propositions.rationale: The HR verification note records a check of the certificate on the issuer's verification page.

expectedGap: The documented work is in UAT, pre-production and performance-test clusters, with production approval and deployment held by the client's release management; production operation, change approvals by the candidate and on-call duty are not documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the infrastructure code, dashboards and fault-injection testing in the environments named and keep the verified certificate; record the 'live since March' remark as the candidate's self-report with relayed detail.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which production responsibilities the candidate held for the settlement-file service, including change approvals, deployment permissions and any on-call duty.
